title: Transitive or Intransitive: 開く or 開ける?
description: Pick the right verb of the pair and put it in the right form — が and を are your clues.

points.title: Intransitive: it happens (が)
points.summary: Transitive & intransitive pairs: Something happens (が + intransitive) or someone does it (を + transitive).
points.body:
- **Intransitive** (自動詞): the thing itself is the subject, nobody acts on it — ドア**が開く**, 電気**が消える**.
- **Transitive** (他動詞): someone does it to something marked with を — ドア**を開ける**, 電気**を消す**.
- Typical pairs: 開く / 開ける, 閉まる / 閉める, 始まる / 始める, 壊れる / 壊す, 落ちる / 落とす, つく / つける, 消える / 消す, 止まる / 止める, 決まる / 決める, 集まる / 集める, 見つかる / 見つける, 入る / 入れる.
- Patterns that help: -aru ↔ -eru (始まる / 始める), -reru ↔ -su (壊れる / 壊す), -eru ↔ -asu (消える / 消す).

**Check:** is there a を? Then you need the transitive verb.

points.title: Transitive: someone does it (を)
points.summary: Transitive & intransitive pairs: Something happens (が + intransitive) or someone does it (を + transitive).
points.body:
- **Intransitive** (自動詞): the thing itself is the subject, nobody acts on it — ドア**が開く**, 電気**が消える**.
- **Transitive** (他動詞): someone does it to something marked with を — ドア**を開ける**, 電気**を消す**.

- Patterns that help: -aru ↔ -eru (始まる / 始める), -reru ↔ -su (壊れる / 壊す), -eru ↔ -asu (消える / 消す).
